---
title: "Tutorials"
---

The tutorials exercise the core RHS-IA workflow with small local projects. Choose the [Jupyter Notebook](jupyter-notebook.qmd) tutorial for an interactive cell-based analysis or the [Quarto](quarto.qmd) tutorial for an executable document.

Before starting, install a supported Python or R interpreter and the packages required by your chosen example. Work in a new folder so generated files and environment configuration remain isolated.

Each tutorial ends with a clean-session check to make sure the result can be reproduced.
